title: 石門水庫大壩
summary: 石門課程從中央心層、濾層、壓實與孔隙水壓開始，再把排砂、分層取水及後池調節納入水量與固體質量帳。學生練習區分土的乾密度與濕密度、濁度與含砂質量濃度，以及排水量上升與內部侵蝕證據。假想地震水平力只用於理解受力，不能替代滑動面或動力分析。
summaryEn: The Shihmen course begins with core zoning, filters, compaction and pore pressure, then brings sediment outlets, selective withdrawal and afterbay buffering into water and solids balances. Learners separate dry from wet density, turbidity from sediment mass concentration, and rising drainage from evidence of erosion. Hypothetical seismic inertia illustrates force bookkeeping without replacing slip-surface or dynamic analysis.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分層心層的串聯滲流」與「濾層粒徑比例篩查」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Series seepage through core layers" and "Filter gradation ratio screening": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Series seepage through core layers: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分層心層的串聯滲流」如何影響石門水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Series seepage through core layers” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中央心層靠低滲透材料限制穿壩水量，不同材料沿流向排列時，每層通過相同流量但消耗不同水頭。等效滲透係數因此是厚度加權的調和平均，較不透水的一層可能支配阻力。這與平行流路的算術平均不同，也不能把分層公式套到裂縫形成的集中流，因為後者改變流路與有效截面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分層心層的串聯滲流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A central core limits flow with low-permeability material. Layers arranged along the flow direction carry the same discharge but consume different head losses, giving a thickness-weighted harmonic equivalent permeability. The least permeable layer can dominate resistance. This differs from parallel-path averaging and does not describe a crack carrying concentrated flow, because that feature changes both geometry and the effective flow area. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Series seepage through core layers” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Permeabilities of layers in series should simply be averaged arithmetically" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分層心層的串聯滲流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Series seepage through core layers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流
knowledge.text: 中央心層靠低滲透材料限制穿壩水量，不同材料沿流向排列時，每層通過相同流量但消耗不同水頭。等效滲透係數因此是厚度加權的調和平均，較不透水的一層可能支配阻力。
knowledge.textEn: A central core limits flow with low-permeability material. Layers arranged along the flow direction carry the same discharge but consume different head losses, giving a thickness-weighted harmonic equivalent permeability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Permeabilities of layers in series should simply be averaged arithmetically Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「石門水庫大壩」的「分層心層的串聯滲流：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出流域、入流、儲存、出流與下游的水量邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「水庫數據調度桌」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的流量、水位、截面與儀器校正紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Series seepage through core layers: mechanism and system paths” in “Shihmen Dam”. Draw the catchment, inflow, storage, outflow and downstream water balance; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Reservoir data planning desk” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for flow, level, section and calibration records for the same time window, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「分層心層的串聯滲流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Series seepage through core layers" is correct?
options: 沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均
中央心層靠低滲透材料限制穿壩水量，不同材料沿流向排列時，每層通過相同流量但消耗不同水頭。
只要一個粒徑比值很小就可保證濾層合格
optionsEn: Permeabilities of layers in series should simply be averaged arithmetically
A central core limits flow with low-permeability material.
A sufficiently small single grain-size ratio guarantees filter acceptance
quiz.explanation: 中央心層靠低滲透材料限制穿壩水量，不同材料沿流向排列時，每層通過相同流量但消耗不同水頭。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A central core limits flow with low-permeability material. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Series seepage through core layers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分層心層的串聯滲流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Series seepage through core layers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。適用邊界：飽和一維達西流、材料均勻無裂縫，截面固定且無側向逸流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Saturated one-dimensional Darcy flow through uniform uncracked materials with constant area and no lateral escape. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。適用邊界：飽和一維達西流、材料均勻無裂縫，截面固定且無側向逸流。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Saturated one-dimensional Darcy flow through uniform uncracked materials with constant area and no lateral escape.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分層心層的串聯滲流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Series seepage through core layers", which statement holds?
options: 庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降
入庫泥砂總質量全部等於當期永久庫容損失
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。
optionsEn: Internal pore pressure always falls immediately by the same amount as reservoir level
All incoming sediment mass equals permanent capacity loss in that period
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Series seepage through core layers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分層心層的串聯滲流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Series seepage through core layers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。核對室內試體方向與現地壓實方向是否一致，保留溫度與飽和程度，並以排水量獨立檢查總流量而非只信等效係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge. Match laboratory specimen orientation to field compaction, retain temperature and saturation information, and use measured drainage as an independent check on total flow. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把第二層滲透係數加倍，重新求流量與兩層水頭分配，再將層厚互換比較，說明為何幾何與材料阻力必須一起記錄而不能只報一個平均係數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double the second permeability, recalculate discharge and head distribution, then interchange layer thicknesses. Explain why geometry and material resistance must be reported together rather than reduced to an unexplained average coefficient.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把兩層係數直接平均會低估低滲透層的控制作用；但若低滲透層已有裂縫，仍堅持完整材料模型又會低估集中流量，兩種錯誤方向並不相同。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Arithmetic averaging underestimates control by the less permeable layer. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。核對室內試體方向與現地壓實方向是否一致，保留溫度與飽和程度，並以排水量獨立檢查總流量而非只信等效係數。
knowledge.textEn: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge. Match laboratory specimen orientation to field compaction, retain temperature and saturation information, and use measured drainage as an independent check on total flow.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把第二層滲透係數加倍，重新求流量與兩層水頭分配，再將層厚互換比較，說明為何幾何與材料阻力必須一起記錄而不能只報一個平均係數。
knowledge.textEn: Double the second permeability, recalculate discharge and head distribution, then interchange layer thicknesses. Explain why geometry and material resistance must be reported together rather than reduced to an unexplained average coefficient.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分層心層的串聯滲流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Series seepage through core layers"?
options: 以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要放流水量大就能保證排出的泥砂很多
optionsEn: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A large water release guarantees a large exported sediment mass
quiz.explanation: 以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Series seepage through core layers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分層心層的串聯滲流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Series seepage through core layers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把兩層係數直接平均會低估低滲透層的控制作用；但若低滲透層已有裂縫，仍堅持完整材料模型又會低估集中流量，兩種錯誤方向並不相同。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Arithmetic averaging underestimates control by the less permeable layer. Conversely, retaining an intact-material model after cracking can understate concentrated flow, so the two modeling errors do not share the same direction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這與平行流路的算術平均不同，也不能把分層公式套到裂縫形成的集中流，因為後者改變流路與有效截面。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This differs from parallel-path averaging and does not describe a crack carrying concentrated flow, because that feature changes both geometry and the effective flow area.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Permeabilities of layers in series should simply be averaged arithmetically" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把兩層係數直接平均會低估低滲透層的控制作用；但若低滲透層已有裂縫，仍堅持完整材料模型又會低估集中流量，兩種錯誤方向並不相同。
knowledge.textEn: Arithmetic averaging underestimates control by the less permeable layer. Conversely, retaining an intact-material model after cracking can understate concentrated flow, so the two modeling errors do not share the same direction.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分層心層的串聯滲流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Series seepage through core layers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把兩層係數直接平均會低估低滲透層的控制作用；但若低滲透層已有裂縫，仍堅持完整材料模型又會低估集中流量，兩種錯誤方向並不相同。
只要一個粒徑比值很小就可保證濾層合格
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Arithmetic averaging underestimates control by the less permeable layer.
A sufficiently small single grain-size ratio guarantees filter acceptance
quiz.explanation: 把兩層係數直接平均會低估低滲透層的控制作用；但若低滲透層已有裂縫，仍堅持完整材料模型又會低估集中流量，兩種錯誤方向並不相同。 需以量測區分可能原因。

steps.title: 濾層粒徑比例篩查：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Filter gradation ratio screening: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「濾層粒徑比例篩查」如何影響石門水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Filter gradation ratio screening” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 心層旁的濾層既要容許水排出，也要阻止細料隨流失去。粒徑分位數比例可作初步相容性討論，但其物理目的與材料分布形狀都要清楚。單一比例沒有描述間斷級配、塑性細料或施工離析，因此本課只計算幾何比值，不提供通用驗收門檻或取代專門濾層試驗。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「濾層粒徑比例篩查」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A filter beside the core must pass water while retaining soil particles. Ratios of grain-size percentiles support preliminary compatibility discussion only when their physical purpose and the full gradation shape are understood. One ratio does not capture gap grading, plastic fines or construction segregation, so the calculation reports geometry rather than a universal acceptance threshold and does not replace a dedicated filter test. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Filter gradation ratio screening” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要一個粒徑比值很小就可保證濾層合格」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently small single grain-size ratio guarantees filter acceptance" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「濾層粒徑比例篩查」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Filter gradation ratio screening”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 濾層粒徑比例篩查
knowledge.text: 心層旁的濾層既要容許水排出，也要阻止細料隨流失去。粒徑分位數比例可作初步相容性討論，但其物理目的與材料分布形狀都要清楚。
knowledge.textEn: A filter beside the core must pass water while retaining soil particles. Ratios of grain-size percentiles support preliminary compatibility discussion only when their physical purpose and the full gradation shape are understood.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要一個粒徑比值很小就可保證濾層合格 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently small single grain-size ratio guarantees filter acceptance Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「濾層粒徑比例篩查」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Filter gradation ratio screening" is correct?
options: 只要一個粒徑比值很小就可保證濾層合格
含水率百分之十二可直接以十二代入換算式
心層旁的濾層既要容許水排出，也要阻止細料隨流失去。
optionsEn: A sufficiently small single grain-size ratio guarantees filter acceptance
Twelve percent water content can be entered as twelve in the conversion
A filter beside the core must pass water while retaining soil particles.
quiz.explanation: 心層旁的濾層既要容許水排出，也要阻止細料隨流失去。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A filter beside the core must pass water while retaining soil particles. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 濾層粒徑比例篩查：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Filter gradation ratio screening: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「濾層粒徑比例篩查」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Filter gradation ratio screening” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8。適用邊界：粒徑均為重量通過百分比的同單位數據，只作比值計算，不宣告材料合格。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8. Applicable boundary: Both percentiles use the same size unit and mass-passing convention; this is a ratio calculation, not material acceptance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：繪完整粒徑曲線並標明取樣位置，確認百分之十五與八十五是通過率而非留置率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot the complete gradation and sampling locations, confirming that fifteen and eighty-five percent denote passing rather than retained mass.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8。適用邊界：粒徑均為重量通過百分比的同單位數據，只作比值計算，不宣告材料合格。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8. Applicable boundary: Both percentiles use the same size unit and mass-passing convention; this is a ratio calculation, not material acceptance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「濾層粒徑比例篩查」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Filter gradation ratio screening", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8。
等效水平力計算完成就能排除地震永久變形
孔口流量與水頭成正比而不是平方根關係
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8.
Calculating equivalent horizontal force rules out permanent seismic deformation
Orifice discharge is proportional to head rather than its square root
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 濾層粒徑比例篩查：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Filter gradation ratio screening: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「濾層粒徑比例篩查」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Filter gradation ratio screening” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 繪完整粒徑曲線並標明取樣位置，確認百分之十五與八十五是通過率而非留置率。比較施工前後級配與細料遷移試驗，若局部粗化或離析，應另看局部曲線，不能只用整批平均值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot the complete gradation and sampling locations, confirming that fifteen and eighty-five percent denote passing rather than retained mass. Compare preconstruction and placed material with migration tests, examining local curves where segregation occurs instead of relying on a batch average. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將假想濾料離析成粗細兩區，各自重新計算比值並與合併樣本比較，提出能辨識局部風險的取樣配置，而不要自行訂定現地允許值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Split hypothetical filter material into coarse and fine segregated zones, calculate each ratio and compare with the blended sample. Propose sampling locations that reveal local risk without inventing field acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把通過率與留置率顛倒會選錯粒徑；以一個看似漂亮的比值掩蓋施工離析，可能讓局部濾層過粗而失去保土功能，即使整體樣本仍維持原級配。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reversing passing and retained percentages selects the wrong sizes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 繪完整粒徑曲線並標明取樣位置，確認百分之十五與八十五是通過率而非留置率。比較施工前後級配與細料遷移試驗，若局部粗化或離析，應另看局部曲線，不能只用整批平均值。
knowledge.textEn: Plot the complete gradation and sampling locations, confirming that fifteen and eighty-five percent denote passing rather than retained mass. Compare preconstruction and placed material with migration tests, examining local curves where segregation occurs instead of relying on a batch average.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將假想濾料離析成粗細兩區，各自重新計算比值並與合併樣本比較，提出能辨識局部風險的取樣配置，而不要自行訂定現地允許值。
knowledge.textEn: Split hypothetical filter material into coarse and fine segregated zones, calculate each ratio and compare with the blended sample. Propose sampling locations that reveal local risk without inventing field acceptance limits.

quiz.question: 要驗證「濾層粒徑比例篩查」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Filter gradation ratio screening"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
繪完整粒徑曲線並標明取樣位置，確認百分之十五與八十五是通過率而非留置率。
每次脈衝都可以重新使用整座後池總容量
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Plot the complete gradation and sampling locations, confirming that fifteen and eighty-five percent denote passing rather than retained mass.
Every new pulse can reuse the entire gross afterbay capacity
quiz.explanation: 繪完整粒徑曲線並標明取樣位置，確認百分之十五與八十五是通過率而非留置率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot the complete gradation and sampling locations, confirming that fifteen and eighty-five percent denote passing rather than retained mass. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 濾層粒徑比例篩查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Filter gradation ratio screening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「濾層粒徑比例篩查」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Filter gradation ratio screening” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把通過率與留置率顛倒會選錯粒徑；以一個看似漂亮的比值掩蓋施工離析，可能讓局部濾層過粗而失去保土功能，即使整體樣本仍維持原級配。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reversing passing and retained percentages selects the wrong sizes. An attractive single ratio can conceal segregation that leaves local filter zones too coarse to retain soil even when the combined sample remains unchanged. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單一比例沒有描述間斷級配、塑性細料或施工離析，因此本課只計算幾何比值，不提供通用驗收門檻或取代專門濾層試驗。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: One ratio does not capture gap grading, plastic fines or construction segregation, so the calculation reports geometry rather than a universal acceptance threshold and does not replace a dedicated filter test.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要一個粒徑比值很小就可保證濾層合格」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently small single grain-size ratio guarantees filter acceptance" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把通過率與留置率顛倒會選錯粒徑；以一個看似漂亮的比值掩蓋施工離析，可能讓局部濾層過粗而失去保土功能，即使整體樣本仍維持原級配。
knowledge.textEn: Reversing passing and retained percentages selects the wrong sizes. An attractive single ratio can conceal segregation that leaves local filter zones too coarse to retain soil even when the combined sample remains unchanged.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「濾層粒徑比例篩查」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Filter gradation ratio screening" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
含水率百分之十二可直接以十二代入換算式
把通過率與留置率顛倒會選錯粒徑；以一個看似漂亮的比值掩蓋施工離析，可能讓局部濾層過粗而失去保土功能，即使整體樣本仍維持原級配。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Twelve percent water content can be entered as twelve in the conversion
Reversing passing and retained percentages selects the wrong sizes.
quiz.explanation: 把通過率與留置率顛倒會選錯粒徑；以一個看似漂亮的比值掩蓋施工離析，可能讓局部濾層過粗而失去保土功能，即使整體樣本仍維持原級配。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reversing passing and retained percentages selects the wrong sizes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
